exposure: priming vaginal misoprostol dose (200 mg vs. 400 mg)
oral misoprostol dose regimen (200 mg at 6-hour intervals)
cohort: The study included 101 patients admitted for second-trimester pregnancy termination who received misoprostol between January 2008 and August 2013.
finding: Higher parity, intrauterine fetal demise, and preterm premature rupture of membranes were associated with a shorter abortion interval.
birth_weight: Fetal birth body weight was measured as a factor, with lower weight associated with successful delivery within 12 hours.
